BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2023)
CLASS:  B.TECH/B.ARCH   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH:  ECE/EEE/CSE/IT/MECH/PROD/BARCH SESSION : SP/2023

SUBJECT: CE429 DISASTER MANAGEMENT
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Distinguish between hazard and disaster with suitable examples. [2] 1 2
Q.1(b) Interpret the reasons for environmental disasters. [3] 1, 3 3


Q.2(a) Define risk and vulnerability. Briefly, explain vulnerability assessment.  [2] 1, 3 1, 2
Q.2(b) Describe the different meteorological disasters. [3] 1, 3 3


Q.3(a) Illustrate the FMEA process. [2] 2, 3 3
Q.3(b) Examine the main elements of disaster risk reduction. [3] 2, 3 4


Q.4(a) Summarize HAZOP process. [2] 2 2
Q.4(b) Examine the two-phase method of disaster management. [3] 2, 3 4


Q.5(a) Define flood. Discuss the different types of floods. [2] 1, 3 1, 2
Q.5(b) Analyse the different flood management and mitigation measures. [3] 3 4

Q1 (b) Discuss the difference between “Hazard” and “Disaster”. [3] 1 VI

Q2 (b) What are the types of disasters ? Distinguish between them.  [3] 1 I


Q3 (a) Define “Risk”. [2] 2 I
Q3 (b) What do you mean by “Crisis management” ? [3] 2 I


Q4 (a) Explain disaster management cycle briefly. [2] 2 II

Q5 (a) When the “Disaster Management Act” was introduced in India ? [2] 2 I
Q5 (b) Discuss briefly the framework / methodology of disaster management in India [3] 2 VI
